en.title: Make the cash bridge add up.
en.intro: A small, exact-decimal tool and practical notes for reconciling the cash you started with, the flows in between, and the cash reported at year-end.
en.description: Reconcile cash-flow statements locally with explicit FX, signed net flows and exact decimals. English and Spanish tutorials.
en.panel_intro: Cashflow Bridge Check uses Python 3.11+ and the standard library. It checks arithmetic, not investment merit.
en.panel_body:
python cashflow_bridge.py examples/reconciled.json --json
# calculated 103; reported 103; difference 0

Source download and full JSON schema: cashflow-bridge-check. No installation or API key required.
en.about:
This notebook and Cashflow Bridge Check are maintained under faigvain-ang by the same team developing related Eqvero, KolmoPDF and KomoPDF ecosystem tools. We disclose that connection rather than presenting these pages as independent product reviews.

This site focuses on checking public-reporting arithmetic. Eqvero is the related product for source-linked research into public filings and company disclosures. This CLI is not an Eqvero API client, a data feed or a recommendation engine. Neither a matching bridge nor a linked product guarantees that the source is correct.
en.about_description: Maintenance, product relationships and data handling at Cashflow Fieldnotes.

es.title: Que cuadre el puente de efectivo.
es.intro: Una herramienta decimal pequeña y notas prácticas para conciliar el saldo inicial, los flujos del período y el efectivo declarado al cierre.
es.description: Concilie flujos de efectivo en local con efecto cambiario explícito, flujos con signo y decimales exactos. Guías en inglés y español.
es.panel_intro: Cashflow Bridge Check utiliza Python 3.11+ y su biblioteca estándar. Comprueba aritmética, no el atractivo de una inversión.
es.panel_body:
python cashflow_bridge.py examples/reconciled.json --json
# calculado 103; declarado 103; diferencia 0

Código y esquema JSON completo: cashflow-bridge-check. Sin instalación ni clave API.
